prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic conceptual portrait of an adult woman standing still inside a rushing urban crowd. She has a short wavy brown bob, wears a light striped button-up shirt, and faces the camera with a quiet unsettled expression. Apply extreme radial motion blur to anonymous pedestrians and city edges while keeping her face sharply frozen. Place an intense warm light burst directly behind her head in a narrow city street to create bold golden backlight, graphic cinematic framing, psychological tension, existential solitude, surreal realism, and experimental fashion-editorial energy. Use a 50mm lens at f/2.8, controlled slow-shutter blur, natural skin texture, and portrait 4:5 framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, duplicate subject
